original_test_intent: Confirm every installed NVIDIA GPU and its FRU/identity information is consistently represented across BIOS, UEFI shell, BMC and Linux, with the correct PCIe endpoint/upstream link speed and width for the platform design.
original_method: Establish signed expected inventory/topology, stable UUID/serial/slot/BDF/FRU map and per-plane field mapping; capture OS/BMC read-only data, obtain maintenance/OOB approval for BIOS/UEFI inspection, collect `pci -i` and BIOS evidence without changes, reconcile every device/field/link to the spec, return OS and revalidate count/identity/link/driver/log health.
manual_activity: Operator supervises BIOS/UEFI entry and evidence capture, approves reboot/OOB recovery and supplies expected inventory/topology; agent may reconcile read-only outputs.
required_inputs: Per-plane expected fields/values and absent-field policy
Maintenance/reboot approval, console/OOB recovery and protected/redacted evidence
safety_requirements: Preserve active-job and log baseline before reboot
Use read-only BIOS/UEFI navigation and commands; make no setup change
Never infer identity from enumeration index or substring alone
Protect serial/asset/credential data and verify BMC/host target
Stop on missing GPU, unexpected link, boot/driver/management anomaly and recover via approved console
agent_execution_scope: Coordinate approved BIOS/UEFI evidence capture without settings changes
Post-boot verify health and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expected inventory/topology and field mapping
Authorize BIOS/UEFI/reboot and resolve plane differences

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It covers only a filtered OS/BMC subset, uses unsafe transport/quoting and cannot prove BIOS/UEFI or full link state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved local/OOB read-only `nvidia-smi`, full `lspci -vvv`, BMC inventory, UEFI `pci -i` and BIOS evidence, all mapped by stable physical identity rather than index.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UEFI `pci`/`pci -i`, Linux `lspci -vvv` and five-minute nominal timing remain; required reboot/inspection time must be governed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create one row per physical GPU with UUID/serial/slot/BDF/FRU plus BIOS/UEFI/BMC/OS observed fields, endpoint/upstream capabilities/negotiated link and expected values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes 'show correctly' a complete cross-plane reconciliation rather than visual or grep confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS visibility alone cannot establish firmware/BMC enumeration or FRU parity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some planes legitimately omit fields; an approved mapping/optionality rule is needed to distinguish expected absence from lost coverage.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner determines whether link must equal maximum capability or a workload/power-state negotiated value and which FRU fields are exposed per plane.
expected_evidence: Expected spec revision and stable physical GPU/topology/FRU map
Full nvidia-smi, lspci capability/status and BMC inventory with hashes/timestamps
BIOS screenshots/export and UEFI `pci -i` per device
Endpoint/upstream speed/width capability and negotiated-state comparison
Reboot/OOB audit, post-OS GPU/driver/log health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master coherently requires cross-plane inventory and PCIe link verification; DeepSeek only undercovers it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Specification, access and maintenance approval are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores BIOS/UEFI coverage, uses stable physical identity and converts broad correctness into per-field/link traceability.
independent_technical_reasoning: Enumeration order can differ after reboot and between firmware and OS, so index-based equality can pair the wrong devices. Stable serial/slot/UUID/BDF topology is required before comparing FRU and link data. PCIe correctness also needs both endpoint and upstream capabilities plus negotiated state; a lower speed may be expected at idle but not under the project oracle. Hybrid manual evidence is unavoidable because OS commands cannot observe the BIOS page or UEFI shell state.
